item.title: Nepal’s Hydropower Industry Was Booming. Now 900 Workers Are Missing.
item.description: Videos show rescuers pulling people out of hydropower tunnels, as hundreds of workers remain missing after a deadly flood.

item.title: Why Many Iranians Are Losing Hope After Six Months of War
item.description: Iranians have become increasingly desperate, as they grapple with an economic crisis made worse by the conflict and grow increasingly skeptical about President Trump’s motives.

item.title: Palestine Action Activists Accused of Vandalism at Trump Turnberry Face Terrorism Accusation
item.description: Prosecutors will seek to prove that members of Palestine Action who they say painted “Gaza is not 4 sale” on the Scottish golf course last year committed acts connected to terrorism.

item.title: Live Updates: New Nepal Flood Warning Complicates Desperate Himalayan Search
item.description: A spokeswoman for the Nepali disaster relief agency said the tally grew to 1,900 after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new flooding.

item.title: Six Months In, Iran Appears Stronger and U.S. Goals Unclear
item.description: Trump’s replacement of a military war with a heightened economic one is not expected to alter Iran’s strategy, while further impoverishing its people.

item.title: Unstable Manhattan Building Had More Damaged Columns Than Previously Known
item.description: Drawings obtained by The New York Times and reviewed by engineers show insufficient reinforcements on eight more steel columns than previously known at a Manhattan building.

item.title: Fear Over Malaysia’s Plan to Send Back Rohingya Migrants to Myanmar
item.description: The announcement has sent panic through a community that fled its country’s brutal military rule, civil war, religious persecution or some combination of the three.

item.title: A Melting Glacier in Nepal Was a Time Bomb. There Are More to Come.
item.description: A geologist reflects on the disaster and explains why rapid warming will make deadly glacial floods far more common.
